title: Giving your opinion
focus: 认为、同意、反对、支持、有道理、说实话、确实、毕竟
body:
# Giving your opinion

Words for saying what you think, agreeing, and pushing back. These are the building blocks for most of the later lessons, so they will keep coming back.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 认为 | rènwéi | to believe / hold that (considered opinion) | recognize X as Y → considered view |
| 同意 | tóngyì | to agree (with a person or proposal) | same idea → agree |
| 反对 | fǎnduì | to oppose / be against | face against → oppose |
| 支持 | zhīchí | to support / back (a person, a decision) | prop up and hold → back |
| 有道理 | yǒu dàolǐ | to make sense / have a point (what you say ___) | has way and reason → makes sense |
| 说实话 | shuō shíhuà | to be honest… (sentence opener) | speak the real words → honestly |
| 确实 | quèshí | indeed / really (confirming) | firm + real → indeed |
| 毕竟 | bìjìng | after all (giving the reason to accept something) | finished, to the end → after all |

## Which word?

**认为 vs 觉得.** 觉得 is a gut feeling (我觉得有点冷). 认为 is a view you have thought through and would defend (我认为这个办法不行).

## Sentences

- 说实话，我不同意你的看法。 shuō shíhuà, wǒ bù tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ: To be honest, I don't agree with you.
- 我妈反对，可是我爸支持我。 wǒ mā fǎnduì, kěshì wǒ bà zhīchí wǒ: My mum's against it, but my dad's backing me.
- 他的话确实有道理。 tā de huà quèshí yǒu dàolǐ: What he said really does make sense.
- 我同意，毕竟是你的钱。 wǒ tóngyì, bìjìng shì nǐ de qián: I agree. It's your money, after all.
- 很多人认为房价太高了。 hěn duō rén rènwéi fángjià tài gāo le: A lot of people believe house prices are too high.
- 他毕竟是老板，你反对也没用。 tā bìjìng shì lǎobǎn, nǐ fǎnduì yě méi yòng: He's the boss after all, so objecting won't help.
- 我认为你应该支持她。 wǒ rènwéi nǐ yīnggāi zhīchí tā: I believe you should back her up.
- 说实话，你妈说得也有道理。 shuō shíhuà, nǐ mā shuō de yě yǒu dàolǐ: To be honest, your mum has a point too.

cards.Example: 我认为这个方案可行。 wǒ rènwéi zhège fāng'àn kěxíng: I believe this plan is workable
cards.Notes: 认 rèn recognize, 讠 speech (认识, 认真) + 为 wéi take as, become (成为, 以为) = recognize X as Y, so hold a considered view. More reasoned and formal than 觉得 (a gut feeling); 以为 = thought (wrongly).

cards.English: to agree (with a person or proposal)
cards.Example: 你同意的话,我们就这么定了。 nǐ tóngyì de huà, wǒmen jiù zhème dìng le: If you agree, then it's settled
cards.Notes: 同 tóng same (同学, 不同) + 意 yì idea, intention (意思, 注意) = same idea, so agree / give consent. Mirror: 不同意. vs 赞成 = more formal 'be in favor of'.

cards.Example: 很多人反对这个政策。 hěn duō rén fǎnduì zhège zhèngcè: A lot of people oppose this policy
cards.Notes: 反 fǎn reverse, against (相反, 反正) + 对 duì face, toward (对面, 对手) = face against, so oppose. Mirror: 支持 / 赞成. 坚决反对 = firmly oppose.

cards.English: to support / back (a person, a decision)
cards.Example: 不管你做什么决定,我都支持你。 bùguǎn nǐ zuò shénme juédìng, wǒ dōu zhīchí nǐ: Whatever you decide, I'll support you
cards.Notes: 支 zhī prop up (支撑; 一支笔 a stick) + 持 chí hold, 扌 hand (坚持, 保持) = prop up and hold, so back a person or decision. Mirror: 反对. Shares 持 with 坚持.

cards.English: to make sense / have a point (what you say ___)
cards.Example: 你说的也有道理。 nǐ shuō de yě yǒu dàolǐ: You have a point there
cards.Notes: 道理 dàolǐ: 道 dào way, road (知道, 道路) + 理 lǐ reason, logic (理由, 合理) = the way and reason of things, so 有道理 = makes sense. Adding 也 softens it: 'you have a point too' before you push back.

cards.Example: 说实话,我不太喜欢这个方案。 shuō shíhuà, wǒ bú tài xǐhuan zhège fāng'àn: To be honest, I don't really like this plan
cards.Notes: 说 shuō speak + 实 shí real, solid (其实, 老实) + 话 huà words (说话, 电话) = speak the real words, so 'to be honest…'. Also 说实在的 / 老实说, same meaning.

cards.Example: 你说得确实有道理。 nǐ shuō de quèshí yǒu dàolǐ: You really do have a point
cards.Notes: 确 què firm, certain, 石 stone (确定, 正确) + 实 shí real, solid (真实, 老实) = solidly true: indeed. 的确 means the same and is a bit more written.

cards.English: after all (giving the reason to accept something)
cards.Example: 别怪他了，他毕竟还是个孩子。 bié guài tā le, tā bìjìng hái shì ge háizi: Don't blame him, he's still a kid after all
cards.Notes: 毕 bì finish (毕业 graduate) + 竟 jìng to the end (竟然, 究竟) = when all is said and done: after all. Don't confuse with 究竟 (究 investigate to the end = exactly, in questions: 究竟怎么回事？).

cards.English: To be honest, I don't agree with you.
cards.Hanzi: 说实话，我不同意你的看法。
cards.Pinyin: shuō shíhuà, wǒ bù tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ.
cards.Notes: 说实话 (L1) + 同意 (L1). 不 stays bù before a 2nd tone; it only changes before a 4th.

cards.English: My mum's against it, but my dad's backing me.
cards.Hanzi: 我妈反对，可是我爸支持我。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ mā fǎnduì, kěshì wǒ bà zhīchí wǒ.
cards.Notes: 反对 (L1) + 支持 (L1). 反对 and 支持 are a mirror pair.

cards.English: What he said really does make sense.
cards.Pinyin: tā de huà quèshí yǒu dàolǐ.
cards.Notes: 确实 (L1) + 有道理 (L1). 确实 sits right before the verb phrase.

cards.English: I agree. It's your money, after all.
cards.Pinyin: wǒ tóngyì, bìjìng shì nǐ de qián.
cards.Notes: 同意 (L1) + 毕竟 (L1). 毕竟 gives the reason you accept something.

cards.English: A lot of people believe house prices are too high.
cards.Hanzi: 很多人认为房价太高了。
cards.Pinyin: hěn duō rén rènwéi fángjià tài gāo le.

cards.English: He's the boss after all, so objecting won't help.
cards.Hanzi: 他毕竟是老板，你反对也没用。
cards.Pinyin: tā bìjìng shì lǎobǎn, nǐ fǎnduì yě méi yòng.
cards.Notes: 毕竟 (L1) + 反对 (L1). X 也没用 = 'even if you X, it's no use'.

cards.English: I believe you should back her up.
cards.Pinyin: wǒ rènwéi nǐ yīnggāi zhīchí tā.

cards.English: To be honest, your mum has a point too.
cards.Hanzi: 说实话，你妈说得也有道理。
cards.Pinyin: shuō shíhuà, nǐ mā shuō de yě yǒu dàolǐ.
cards.Notes: 说实话 (L1) + 有道理 (L1). 也 softens it: 'she has a point too'.
